config.surface.title: Configuration · {project}
config.surface.service.current: The running service already uses this configuration.
config.surface.service.stale: Restart required: the running service started with the previous configuration. Restart it with `deckent runtime restart` (or /service-restart in the terminal).
config.surface.service.unknown: Whether the running service uses this value could not be determined (it reports no configuration fingerprint). Restart it with `deckent runtime restart` to be sure.
config.surface.service.stopped: No service is running; the value applies at the next service start.
config.surface.overridden: Saved value is overridden by a later layer (project or environment).
config.surface.slashUsage: /config [key] · view. /config set <key> <json> · /config unset <key> · change the project layer (policy authorization; an approval may be asked).
config.surface.help:
deckent config [--json] [--global] [--lang en|tr]

Inspect
  get [key] [--json]       compatible value output
  explain <key> [--json]   description, schema, source and binding
  validate                validate the full effective configuration

Change (policy authorization required; a policy may ask for an approval first — nothing is written until it is allowed)
  set <key> <json> [--global] [--expect <digest|absent>] [--scope <id>]
  unset <key> [--global] [--expect <digest|absent>] [--scope <id>]
  --command-id <id>       audit command identity
Use --expect absent to require a missing document. Explain uses the project view; --global is refused. Project is the default write layer. Secrets use deckent secret.
Use explain to see environment overrides and restart requirements.
config.surface.fieldRetired: Removed unused setting {key}; document schema 3 is read as schema 4.
error.CONFIG_SECRET_SECTION_REFUSED: Secrets must be changed with deckent secret. Configuration writes to the secrets section are refused.
error.CONFIG_LAYER_INVALID: Choose project or global as the configuration write layer.
error.CONFIG_DIGEST_INVALID: Expected document digest must be a 64-character SHA-256 hexadecimal digest.
error.CONFIG_ARRAY_INDEX_INVALID: Configuration array index must be canonical, within range, and owned by the array.
error.CONFIG_KEY_NOT_OBJECT: The configuration path traverses a scalar; set its parent document instead.
error.CONFIG_METADATA_MISSING: Configuration section metadata is incomplete; binding and apply information are required.
